channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Partidos acionam Justiça contra personagem de IA que viraliza com vídeos atacando Lula e o STF
item.description: The PT, PV, and PCdoB parties, members of the Brazil of Hope Federation, filed a representation with the TSE requesting the suspension and removal of an AI-generated character whose viral videos attacked President Lula and the Supreme Federal Court (STF). The parties argue the content constitutes disinformation and an affront to democratic institutions, violating electoral law.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Eduardo terá papel decisivo na definição de chapa ao Senado em SP
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro stated that the definition of Senate candidates on the PL ticket in São Paulo will depend directly on former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro. The comment was made following an event in the interior of São Paulo state alongside Governor Tarcísio de Freitas.

item.title: Fux é o relator de ação do PDT para anular eleição de Ruas na Alerj
item.description: Minister Luiz Fux of the STF has been appointed as rapporteur in a PDT action seeking to annul the election of Douglas Ruas as president of the Alerj, held by open vote on April 17 with 44 votes in favor and one abstention. The party argues the vote violated constitutional principles, republican values, and the internal rules of the legislature, occurring amid an institutional crisis in Rio de Janeiro without a governor or vice-governor. The PDT also requests that the STF order a new secret-ballot election for the Alerj's directing board.

item.title: “Se Lula achou que a faixa era para ele, quem sou eu pra discordar”, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, commented on the removal of a banner reading 'THIEF' in Presidente Prudente (SP) by Federal Police agents, saying that if Lula believed the banner was aimed at him, he had no reason to disagree. The banner did not explicitly mention Lula’s name but was interpreted as a reference to him. The incident occurred shortly before Lula’s scheduled visit to the city.

item.title: Lula promove jantar para Dilma Rousseff no Palácio da Alvorada
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva hosted a dinner for former president Dilma Rousseff at the Palácio da Alvorada, attended by former ministers and aides from her administration. Dilma, who currently leads the New Development Bank and resides in Shanghai, is in Brazil for institutional engagements, including talks on energy infrastructure and BRICS partnerships. The gathering comes ten years after the impeachment process that removed her from office in 2016 began.

item.title: Congresso define nesta semana se mantém veto de Lula a PL da Dosimetria; entenda
item.description: Congress is voting Thursday on whether to override or uphold President Lula’s veto of the Dosimetria Bill, which would recalculate sentences to benefit those convicted in the January 8 attacks, allowing regime progression after serving one-sixth of a sentence. The bill could benefit former President Jair Bolsonaro, sentenced to 27 years, and includes an amendment by Sérgio Moro reducing penalties for crimes against the democratic state, even with violence. Overriding the veto requires an absolute majority: 257 votes in the Chamber and 41 in the Senate.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia propõe criar ‘brigadas eleitorais’ para candidatas mulheres nas eleições 2026
item.description: STF Minister Cármen Lúcia proposed the creation of electoral brigades to protect female candidates in the 2026 elections, modeled after the Maria da Penha Patrol. The initiative aims to prevent violence during campaigns and elections through rapid response in imminent risk situations. Lúcia, who presided over the TSE in the 2024 municipal elections, argued the measure is essential to curb rising political violence against women.

item.title: Girão declara voto contra Jorge Messias no STF
item.description: Senator Eduardo Girão (Novo-CE) declared he will vote against Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, arguing that Messias' role as Attorney General shows alignment with the Lula government, undermining the required judicial impartiality. Girão advocates for a technical and independent STF, criticizing the Senate's failure to initiate impeachment proceedings against justices, which he views as enabling institutional decay.

item.title: “Gilmar não deveria ter respondido”, diz Temer sobre Zema
item.description: Former Brazilian President Michel Temer criticized Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes for responding to former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema, stating that Mendes should not have replied. Temer argued that the more Mendes responds, the more ammunition he gives to critics. The remarks were made on Monday, the 27th, in an interview with O Antagonista.

item.title: Como foi a primeira agenda conjunta de Tarcísio e Flávio na pré-campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio de Freitas held their first joint campaign event in the 2026 pre-campaign at the opening of Agrishow in Ribeirão Preto. They exchanged mutual praise, with Flávio highlighting Tarcísio’s loyalty and presidential potential, and the governor calling the senator the 'next president of the Republic'. The event reinforced the articulation of a slate aligned with Jair Bolsonaro’s legacy, including mentions of Senate candidates from São Paulo.

item.title: Personagem de IA que viraliza com vídeos atacando Lula e o STF é alvo de ação de partidos na Justiça
item.description: The PT, PV, and PCdoB parties of the Brazil of Hope Federation filed a representation with the TSE seeking the suspension of the 'Dona Maria' profile, an AI-generated character that spreads videos attacking President Lula, the left, and the STF. The profile uses a realistic image of an elderly Black woman and often fails to disclose its artificial nature, spreading false claims such as a alleged tax on can collectors. The parties allege it constitutes illicit political propaganda, defamation, and monetized disinformation aimed at destabilizing the October election.

item.title: Justiça decide que Renan Santos deve excluir conteúdos que chama Wesley Safadão de 'novo ícone da corrupção'
item.description: A Ceará court ordered Renan Santos, a presidential pre-candidate from the Missão party and former MBL member, to delete a video calling Wesley Safadão a 'new icon of corruption' and refrain from similar posts, under a daily fine of R$ 5,000. The ruling grants provisional relief to Safadão, who sued for defamation. Santos defended the remarks as legitimate criticism and said he expected further legal action.

item.title: Kassab articula palanque para Caiado no Rio
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, said the party is building a political platform in Rio de Janeiro to support Ronaldo Caiado's presidential bid, former governor of Goiás. The strategy involves Rio Mayor Eduardo Paes (PSD), despite Paes having declared support for Lula's (PT) re-election.

item.title: Temer diz que Gilmar não deveria ter respondido a Zema: 'Mais argumentos dá para contestação'
item.description: Former President Michel Temer criticized Justice Gilmar Mendes for responding to criticisms from former governor Romeu Zema, stating that the exchange reflects the polarization that has reached Brazil's Supreme Court.

item.title: O silêncio do governo Trump sobre Paulo Figueiredo
item.description: The U.S. government has not yet responded to a request from Brazil's Supreme Federal Court for judicial cooperation to formally notify blogger Paulo Figueiredo, who is accused of participating in disinformation operations linked to the attempted coup. The Prosecutor General's Office alleges he was responsible for disinformation campaigns in the U.S., and legal notification is required for him to be aware of the proceedings. The U.S. silence is delaying the investigation, which also involves former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Moro denuncia manobra do governo Lula para sabatina de Messias na CCJ do Senado
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro accused the Lula government of orchestrating a maneuver to remove him from the Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) to favor the confirmation hearing of Attorney General Jorge Messias, Lula’s nominee to the Supreme Court. The replacement of Moro with Renan Filho (MDB-AL) and Cid Gomes with Ana Paula Lobato (PSB-MA) is projected to give the government at least 15 favorable votes in the CCJ, exceeding the 14 needed to advance the nomination. Moro stated he will vote against Messias in the plenary and condemned the move as desperate and immoral, claiming it aims to avoid a transparent hearing.

item.title: Moro denuncia “manobra” e antecipa voto contra Jorge Messias no STF
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR) denounced a government base maneuver after being replaced on the Constitution and Justice Committee by Senator Renan Filho, ahead of Jorge Messias' STF confirmation hearing. Moro said the change reflects uncertainty and signaled he will vote against Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Tribunal.

item.title: PL aciona PGR e acusa PT de desinformação contra Flávio
item.description: Deputy Ubiratan Sanderson (PL-RS) filed a complaint with the PGR accusing the PT's National Directorate of spreading disinformation about Senate pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) via an AI-generated video shown at a party congress, falsely linking him to the Master Bank case. The filing requests an investigation, identification of those responsible, electoral legal analysis, and referral to the TSE, arguing the video uses definitive language, emotional appeals, and offensive terms—such as 'the most corrupt son'—to manipulate public opinion and undermine the 2026 electoral process.

item.title: Gleisi criticou 42 vezes editoriais de jornais no governo Lula
item.description: Federal deputy Gleisi Hoffmann (PT-PR) criticized newspaper editorials 42 times since the start of Lula's third term, with Folha de S.Paulo (17), O Globo (13), and Estadão (12) being the most targeted. She accused these outlets of opposing the poor and siding with financial markets, calling Estadão 'mortgaged to banks'. Despite her criticism, she praised one editorial each from Estadão and Globo for opposing the amnesty bill for those involved in the January 8 coup attempt.

item.title: PL nega ligação de Flávio Bolsonaro com Master
item.description: The PL denied any connection between Flávio Bolsonaro and Banco Master, stating there are no investigations involving the senator. The PT released a video on X linking Bolsonaro to a fraud case tied to the former BRB president, Paulo Henrique Costa, claiming the senator’s R$6 million mansion purchase in 2021 benefited from unusually low interest rates below inflation in 2020.

item.title: Pesquisa Nexus: apenas 8% do eleitorado 60+ quer candidato fora da polarização Lula-Bolsonaro
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll shows that only 8% of voters aged 60 and over support a candidate outside the Lula-Bolsonaro polarization, with 46% favoring Lula and 39% backing Flávio Bolsonaro. In contrast, among voters aged 16–24 (Generation Z), 33% prefer an independent candidate, indicating greater openness to new political figures in this age group. If the runoff were held today, Lula would have 46% and Flávio Bolsonaro 45%, within the poll’s two-point margin of error.

item.title: Avanço de Zema sobre o STF reforça ‘rabo preso’ de Flávio ou o ajuda a criar imagem de moderado?
item.description: The article examines whether Romeu Zema's challenge to the STF and his radicalized rhetoric are forcing Flávio Bolsonaro to maintain a moderate image or creating conditions for him to be perceived as a 'reasoned Bolsonaro'. It suggests that Zema, by positioning himself as a more extreme right-wing candidate, may indirectly help Flávio attract moderate voters through contrast, though it remains uncertain whether Flávio will act independently or continue relying on allies to engage in conflict. The piece highlights the destabilizing effect of the Master case on bolsonarism and Zema's emerging role in disrupting the movement's comfort zone, raising questions about Flávio's autonomy and electoral viability.

item.title: Novo Desenrola terá redução de dívida, saque do FGTS e prazo para acabar, diz ministro
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced that the new 'Desenrola 2.0' will offer debt discounts of up to 90% on credit card, overdraft, and personal loans, allowing partial FGTS withdrawals to pay down debt and providing banks with a federal guarantee via the FGO fund. The program, expected to last several months, will be submitted to President Lula for immediate approval to combat unsustainable interest rates harming families.

item.title: Apesar do apoio de Paes a Lula, Kassab prevê palanque para Caiado com ex-prefeito no Rio: ‘Simples assim’
item.description: PSD national president Gilberto Kassab stated the party will build a presidential campaign platform for Ronaldo Caiado in Rio de Janeiro, with Eduardo Paes as the gubernatorial candidate, despite Paes publicly supporting Lula's re-election. Kassab emphasized that this strategy operates alongside PSD's support for other candidates in different states, such as Tarcísio de Freitas in São Paulo and ACM Neto in Bahia, preserving the party's regional autonomy.

item.title: Tarcísio chama Flávio de “próximo presidente da República”
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas referred to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro as the 'next president of the Republic' during an event at Agrishow. The statement was made in a tone of political endorsement, positioning Flávio as a right-wing pre-candidate for the 2026 presidential election.

item.title: Girão defende rejeição de Jorge Messias para ministro do STF
item.description: Senator Eduardo Girão (Novo-CE) advocated for the rejection of Jorge Messias, the Attorney General of the Union, as a nominee to the Supreme Federal Court (STF), arguing that his alignment with the federal government undermines the impartiality required for the position. While acknowledging Messias’ legal qualifications, Girão claimed he maintains 'umbilical ties to Lula and the PT' and stressed the need for a technically independent STF. He also condemned the Senate’s failure to initiate impeachment proceedings against STF ministers, asserting that this inaction has degraded the Court’s moral standing and disrupted the balance of powers.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Zema não se intimida e volta a ironizar ministros do STF
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and 2026 presidential pre-candidate, again mocked Supreme Court justices in a video from the 'Intocáveis' series, following Justice Gilmar Mendes' request to include him in the digital militias inquiry. Zema said he is not intimidated and continued his attacks on the Court, reinforcing his confrontational rhetoric toward the Judiciary.

item.title: Evento do agro com Flávio e Tarcísio tem críticas a Lula, gritos de ‘presidente’ e ‘selfies’ em trator
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos-SP) attended Agrishow in Ribeirão Preto, delivering critical speeches against President Lula and the federal government, focusing on high interest rates, limited public credit for farmers, and land invasions. Flávio received chants of 'president' and 'out Lula', while both walked the fair for over two hours, taking selfies on tractors and harvesters, strengthening their 2026 pre-campaign alliance.

item.title: Justiça manda Renan Santos remover vídeo em que chama Wesley Safadão de ‘ícone da corrupção’
item.description: A Ceará court ordered Renan Santos, a presidential pre-candidate from the Missão party, to remove a video calling Wesley Safadão the 'icon of corruption', under penalty of a daily fine of R$5,000. Safadão’s legal team claims the statements constitute libel, defamation, and insult, linking the artist to illegal schemes without evidence. Despite the court order, Santos posted a new video reiterating his claims about Safadão’s shows being funded by parliamentary amendments in poor Northeastern cities.

item.title: Risco de crescimento de Zema na campanha coloca bolsonarismo em alerta
item.description: Bolsonarism is on alert as Romeu Zema (Novo) gains traction in polls, risking a split in the right-wing vote that could hurt Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) presidential bid. Carlos Bolsonaro criticized his brother’s campaign on social media, comparing Flávio to a 'lambari biting the bait too easily,' warning that Zema’s rise could block a first-round victory over Lula. The tension reflects an internal struggle between radical bolsonaristas, who favor confrontation with the STF and the Master case, and moderates advocating a Centrão-aligned, more inclusive strategy.

item.title: Desenrola 2 terá juros menores para quebrar ciclo da dívida
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced that Desenrola 2 will require banks to offer significantly lower interest rates, especially on credit card, personal loan, and overdraft debts, to break the cycle of unsustainable indebtedness affecting around 20% of Brazilian families. The program combines discounts with cheaper refinancing and is expected to launch this week after presidential approval, with no link to Copom decisions.

item.title: Dino suspende ação sobre crime eleitoral no MA e manda caso ao STF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino issued a preliminary injunction suspending part of an electoral investigation in Maranhão concerning an alleged criminal organization that allegedly circumvented gender quotas. The decision followed references to federal deputy Josimar do Maranhãozinho (PL-MA), who has been convicted of electoral crimes, and ordered the case files to be sent to the Supreme Court for adjudication.

item.title: Os desafios do governo Lula nas eleições: segurança pública
item.description: Public security is a structural challenge for Lula’s government, as the left traditionally views violence as a systemic issue requiring more than police repression — including inequality reduction, education, job creation, and urban improvements. However, the lack of effective policies in recent years and rising insecurity have empowered far-right 'hardline' discourses, which exploit public desperation to promote authoritarian proposals like the 'Bukelization' of Brazil. Datafolha research shows violence is the country’s second-largest problem (19%), behind only health, increasing pressure on the government to deliver concrete and effective solutions.

item.title: Crusoé: “Wesley Safadão não quer que eu seja presidente”, diz Renan
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos (Missão) claimed that singer Wesley Safadão does not want him to be elected president, after being sued by the artist for posting a recording criticizing publicly funded concerts in financially strained municipalities. Renan said Safadão 'lost it' after the video was shared.

item.title: Desenrola 2 terá desconto de até 90% em dívidas, diz ministro
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced that Desenrola 2 will offer discounts of up to 90% on credit card, personal loan, and overdraft debts, with significantly reduced interest rates, targeting tens of millions of Brazilians. The program, to be presented to President Lula this week, includes limited FGTS withdrawals and financial education measures, and is described as an exceptional, non-recurring measure.

item.title: Izalci Lucas informa que PL votará contra indicação de Jorge Messias ao STF
item.description: Senator Izalci Lucas (PL-DF) announced that the Liberal Party will vote against Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, stating Messias must explain his alleged mention by Dilma Rousseff in 2016 and his stance on the January 8 attacks. He also supported overturning President Lula's veto on the Dosimetry Bill (PL 2.162/2023).

item.title: Vice será escolhido com foco em governabilidade, diz Kassab
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD, stated that the vice-presidential pick for Ronaldo Caiado's presidential pre-candidacy will be chosen with a focus on governability and electoral victory. He denied that a name has already been selected and emphasized the decision will be made at the right time, noting that party conventions are scheduled for July.

item.title: PL rebate vídeo do PT que associa Flávio Bolsonaro ao caso Master: 'Não há qualquer investigação que envolva o senador'
item.description: The PL leadership in the Chamber of Deputies issued a statement defending Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after PT-linked materials associated him with the Banco Master scandal, asserting there is no investigation against him and denouncing an effort to construct an artificial narrative. The statement also references a meeting between Banco Master controller Daniel Vorcaro and President Lula, shifting the focus of criticism. This comes amid the PT’s communication strategy during its 8th National Congress, which also approved a manifesto proposing structural reforms, including in the judiciary and political system.

item.title: Lula deve anunciar novo programa de renegociação de dívidas nesta semana, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan said President Lula will announce a new household debt renegotiation program this week, offering discounts of up to 90% and reduced interest rates. Brazilian household indebtedness reached a record 49.9%, according to central bank data released Monday. The government also plans to allow restricted use of FGTS funds to pay off debts under the program.

item.title: Sabatina na CCJ: o caminho de Messias no Senado para virar ministro do STF
item.description: Jorge Messias, nominated by Lula for the STF, will undergo a hearing in the Senate's CCJ on Wednesday (April 29). To be approved, he needs an absolute majority in the plenary (41 of 81 senators) after CCJ approval (14 of 27 votes). The process follows constitutional procedures for appointment as a Supreme Court Justice.

item.title: Gleisi quer tornar conselheiro de Trump ‘persona non grata’ após ofensas contra brasileiras
item.description: Federal Deputy Gleisi Hoffmann (PT-PR) introduced a bill to declare Paolo Zampolli, businessman and Trump’s special envoy for Global Affairs, as 'persona non grata' in Brazil, following his offensive remarks that Brazilian women are 'programmed to extort and cause chaos'. The proposal, grounded in Brazil’s Migration Law and principles of national sovereignty and human dignity, seeks to block his entry, stay, or official activities in the country.

item.title: Temer diz que Gilmar não deveria ter respondido a Zema: ‘Mais argumentos dá para contestação’
item.description: Former President Michel Temer criticized Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes for responding to criticisms from pre-candidate Romeu Zema, arguing that such replies only fuel further opposition to the Court. Temer attributed judicial polarization to the 1988 Constitution’s design, which brings political issues to the Supreme Court, and to a lack of dialogue among the branches of government. Zema has labeled ministers 'untouchables' and accused the STF of living in luxury while Brazilians suffer, following his inclusion in the fake news inquiry for sharing a satirical video about justices and Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Governo vai liberar uso de FGTS em programa para brasileiros endividados, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan announced the government plans to allow FGTS funds to be used in a new program for indebted Brazilians, with restrictions on withdrawals tied to debt repayment. The initiative, still being structured, proposes up to 90% discounts on credit card, consumer direct credit (CDC), and overdraft debts, targeting those earning up to five minimum wages. Durigan will present the proposal to President Lula on Tuesday for a possible announcement later this week.

item.title: Deputado do PL aciona PGR contra o PT por vídeo que associa Flávio ao caso Master
item.description: Bolsonarist deputy Sanderson (PL-RS) has filed a complaint with the Attorney General's Office (PGR) to investigate alleged dissemination of fake news after the PT released a video linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the Master case. The deputy claims the video has political-electoral intent and aims to damage the image of former President Jair Bolsonaro's son. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Sóstenes rebate associação de Flávio ao caso Master: “Distorção dos fatos”
item.description: Federal Deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante, leader of the PL in the Chamber, rebutted associations made between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and the Banco Master case, labeling them as a 'recurring strategy of distortion of facts'. He emphasized that the accusations lack foundation and are part of a repetitive pattern of misinformation.

item.title: Em evento oficial do governo de SP, Tarcísio chama Flávio Bolsonaro de 'próximo presidente' e senador promete 'cuidar do povo brasileiro'
item.description: At an official São Paulo government event at Agrishow 2026, Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) called Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) the 'next president of Brazil,' while Flávio pledged to 'care for the Brazilian people,' pointed to changes starting in 2027, praised Jair Bolsonaro’s administration, and emphasized support for agribusiness.

item.title: Lula vai anunciar programa de renegociação de dívidas esta semana, diz Durigan; descontos chegarão a 90%
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan met with CEOs of major banks to finalize details of a federal government debt renegotiation program, to be announced by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by May 1st. The program will offer discounts of up to 90% on debts, with interest rates reduced to 1.99% per month, aiming to shift high-cost debts like credit card and consumer direct credit to cheaper lines such as payroll loans. The goal is to benefit tens of millions of indebted Brazilians by leveraging the financial system and the FGTS fund to facilitate renegotiation.

item.title: “Não vejo Lula nem Flávio ganhando a eleição”, diz Kassab
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD, states he does not see Lula nor Flávio Bolsonaro winning the 2026 election due to high rejection rates (48% according to Nexus/BTG poll). He notes that although Lula and Flávio lead in polls with 41% and 36%-38% respectively, their high rejection makes victory unlikely. Kassab believes other pre-candidates, such as Ronaldo Caiado, currently perform poorly due to lack of national visibility but are expected to grow during the campaign.

item.title: Ministros do TSE avaliam que regras sobre IA nas eleições não são suficientes; caso 'Dona Maria' leva questão ao tribunal
item.description: TSE ministers deem current AI election rules insufficient for 2026, following a lawsuit by PT, PV and PCdoB against the 'Dona Maria' AI persona — a nearly 750k-follower Instagram account spreading decontextualized criticism of left-wing politicians without clear AI labeling. The case underscores monitoring challenges due to the accessibility and affordability of AI tools, with existing rules restricting oversight to content from parties and candidates, leaving out vast volumes of third-party AI-generated viral content.

item.title: Aliados do governo articulam troca de nomes na CCJ do Senado para favorecer aprovação de Messias ao STF
item.description: Government allies negotiated changes in the Senate’s Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) to secure a favorable majority for Jorge Messias’ nomination to the Supreme Court. The adjustments, made between Thursday and Friday last week, replaced opposing or undecided senators with allies, increasing government support to about 16 votes in the committee — two above the required 14. Despite the progress, the vote remains sensitive, with some members still refraining from public declarations.
